summary: Tested Iteration 174 — Histórico de Cotizaciones + InternalEmailInput + eliminación de Anexos en Proyectos. Backend: 10/12 pass, 1 skip, 1 FAIL (PDF 500 for equipment/repair). Frontend: sidebar entry, /historical-quotes page (5 rows, view/PDF buttons, detail modal with Cliente/Total USD/Total Bs/Nº Factura/Responsable/Archivada por/Anexos), /projects sin Anexos — todos OK. InternalEmailInput component correctly implemented (verified code + /api/users/internal-emails returns 18 users).

critical.issue: Returns 500 (KeyError: 'services') for archived quotes of category='equipment' or 'repair'. Only fast_track/implementation succeed. Root cause: /app/backend/routes/quote_history.py L207-208 delegates to routes.quotes.generate_quote_pdf which at /app/backend/routes/quotes.py L555 does `if quote["services"]:` (raw key access) — equipment/repair quotes don't carry 'services' key. 2 of 5 existing archived quotes failed PDF download in testing (qhist_quo_b4dbe09d20ff repair, qhist_quo_7bba617263c6 equipment).

issues: Pre-existing React hydration warning: visual-editor wrapper <span data-ve-dynamic> inserted around <tr>/<th>/<tbody> causes console 'span cannot be child of tbody' / '<tr> cannot be child of <span>' errors. Cosmetic only — tables render correctly. Reported in previous iterations.

action_items: Fix PDF download for equipment/repair archived quotes. Option A: in quote_history.download_quote_history_pdf, branch by quote_category and call the correct generator (e.g., regenerate-equipment-pdf for equipment; appropriate handler for repair). Option B (simpler): in routes/quotes.py:555 use quote.get('services') instead of quote['services'] and add category-based sections — but this likely needs full refactor of generate_quote_pdf to handle non-services categories.

(Optional) Director user (Antonio Castro, acastro@megasoft.com.ve, cargo='Director') exists but password unknown — could not positively verify cargo='Director' non-admin access. Bogus-token test confirms 401/403 for unauthenticated requests.
critical_code_review_comments: quote_history.py blindly delegates PDF generation to implementation-style generator — must branch by quote_category.

archive_quote_to_history is idempotent (existing check) but migrate-legacy endpoint returns 'skipped=0' on re-run because archive_quote_to_history returns the existing doc as truthy, thus counted as 'migrated'. Consider returning a sentinel when already archived to populate 'skipped' correctly.
Access control helper _can_access_history correctly grants access to role='admin' OR cargo='Director' (matches spec B).
GET /api/quotes correctly excludes archived (quotes.py L425 query = {'archived': {'$ne': True}}).
InternalEmailInput component is clean, uses /api/users/internal-emails endpoint, properly applies data-testid for both input and suggestions list, hidden until focused + has results.

rca of the issue: PDF 500 for equipment/repair archived quotes: /app/backend/routes/quote_history.py L206-208 imports routes.quotes.generate_quote_pdf and calls it for ALL categories. That generator (quotes.py L517) is hardcoded for services-based implementation quotes (L555: `if quote["services"]:` raises KeyError when 'services' key absent). Equipment/repair quotes use separate PDF generators (regenerate-equipment-pdf at L1859, etc.). Fix: dispatch in download_quote_history_pdf based on doc['quote_category'] to the proper generator, or make generate_quote_pdf tolerant (use .get('services',[])) and add conditional sections for equipment/hardware/repair_models.
